Claim correction · 2026-11-24T17:57Z · declaration pair, by the claim owner (claim 7137125316)

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

Why: the claim's `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` was the seat's expectation before the diff existed. The dev report (7139917764) measured that pair against the two changeset gates: `narrowed` requires a registered ADR-0087 semantic entry under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`, outside this card's surface, although no schema key, stored row or authored value moves. The same refusal family already landed with exactly this pair: PR #36138's `.changeset/35823-unmanaged-derived-namespace-mismatch.md` (contract review PASS 7067582309, merged on the maintainer's approval) declares `'@objectstack/metadata-protocol': patch`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. This card refuses two more install requests on the same rename path; what a metadata author can write in a package does not change (case 3's body is already refused by `defineStack` and the save door's prefix rule). So the PR follows the precedent: patch, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `Skills-docs` line dropped with the `narrowed` kind. The narrowing still owes the contract-review-tier L2 before the queue.
